strings.text: A narrow strip of pebbles, black trunks and mist between them.
strings.translation: Una estrecha franja de guijarros, troncos negros y niebla entre ellos.

strings.text: The light between the trunks went out for a moment, as if someone had passed in front of it, and came on again.
strings.translation: La lucecita entre los troncos se apagó un instante, como si alguien hubiera pasado por delante, y volvió a encenderse.

strings.text: Between the trunks, left of the light, a motionless figure has appeared.
strings.translation: Entre los troncos, a la izquierda de la lucecita, ha aparecido una figura inmóvil.
